settings.title: Shop as usual
settings.body: Buy your blanks at Pro prices, the same way you order today.

settings.title: Earn [cash_rate] back
settings.body: Threads Cash is calculated on what you pay for eligible merchandise, after discounts, returns and cancellations.

settings.title: Use it toward a future order
settings.body: Once it posts to your account, apply it as store credit at checkout.

settings.question: How much better is Pro pricing?
settings.answer: Pro prices are lower than Member prices on eligible products. The difference varies by style, color, size, sale and bulk pricing, so sign in to see your own prices and compare them on real styles above.

settings.question: How does Threads Cash work?
settings.answer: You earn [cash_rate] back on eligible net merchandise purchases as Threads Cash, added to your account as store credit for future orders. When it posts, how long it lasts and which products are excluded will be confirmed before launch.

settings.question: How does the monthly shipping credit work?
settings.answer: Once a month, take up to [ship_max] off the actual standard shipping charge on a merchandise order of [ship_min] or more. Credits don’t roll over, and orders that already ship free at [free_ship]+ don’t use your credit.

settings.question: Can Pro benefits be combined with sales and bulk discounts?
settings.answer: Pending policy: how Pro pricing stacks with sales, Member Deals and bulk pricing.

settings.question: How much do I need to spend for Pro to pay for itself?
settings.answer: At our current pricing, about [breakeven_annual] a year of blank apparel at Member prices (roughly [breakeven_monthly] a month) covers the [fee] membership through Pro pricing and Threads Cash alone, before any shipping savings. Your products and quantities change this, so try the calculator at the top of this page with your own numbers.

settings.question: What happens if my membership doesn’t pay for itself?
settings.answer: Pending policy: the Pro Promise refunds the difference between your membership value and the fee. First-year vs every-year eligibility and refund timing are still being finalized.

settings.question: When do my Pro benefits begin?
settings.answer: Pending policy: Pro pricing starts once your membership payment is processed. Confirm timing and how a first order placed with the membership is priced.

settings.question: How does renewal work?
settings.answer: Pending policy: Pro is billed once for 12 months. We’ll remind you before it’s due to renew. Automatic renewal is not yet decided.

settings.question: Do I need to own a registered business?
settings.answer: Pending policy: confirm whether Pro is open to every Ashley’s Threads account.
